movement.instructions: Choose movement toward the goal on the right. Usually run right, including during jumps. Use left only to retreat from a wall too tall to jump from this close, or to escape being trapped. Jump is decided separately.

criteria.brake_left: Retreat left to create space for a new jump.

start_jump.instructions: Is a jump needed RIGHT NOW? Only when Mario is grounded and jump_already_held is false. Enemy: use nearest_threat.dx (not horizontal_gap_px). Jump when dx is at most 40 pixels; wait when dx is greater than 40. Wall: jump when terrain.nearest_obstacle.distance_px is at most48 pixels. Pit: jump when terrain.nearest_empty_column_below_feet.edge_distance_px is at most48 pixels. Return false when no such nearby hazard exists. Being under a ceiling is not itself a reason to jump. Do not jump merely because an enemy is visible.

ceiling_hop.instructions: Should Mario hop over a nearby enemy? True if grounded, jump button released, and an enemy is within 32 pixels. False otherwise.

sustain_jump.instructions: Is Mario rising? Hold jump while rising to gain height. Release jump while falling, grounded, or after hitting a ceiling.
